items.headline: Bank earnings rise 20% in Q2 on income growth and lower provisions
items.hook: Indian lenders logged 20% Q2 profit growth as bad-loan provisions declined.
gist: Indian banks reported a 20% rise in Q2 earnings.
Higher interest income and reduced bad-debt provisions are driving bank profitability.
Sustained net interest margin expansion and credit growth trajectories in upcoming quarters.

items.headline: Bank of Baroda hikes 555-day deposit rates by 10 bps to 7.50%
items.hook: Depositors in Bank of Baroda's 555-day special scheme can earn up to 7.50% interest.
gist: Bank of Baroda raised interest rates on its 555-day deposit scheme by 10 bps.
Higher deposit rates attract retail funds but elevate the bank's interest expenditure.
Monitor whether competing public sector lenders follow with similar deposit rate hikes.

items.headline: Foreign investors buy Rs 7,759 crore of Indian G-Secs in November as outflows end
items.hook: Debt inflows reached Rs 7,759 crore following a two-month period of net selling.
gist: FPIs bought Rs 7,759 crore of Indian government bonds in November, reversing two months of selling.
Foreign debt inflows help stabilize the Indian rupee and lower borrowing costs for government.
Future foreign capital flows and movement in global interest rate conditions.

items.headline: RBI releases September 2026 external borrowing data
items.hook: Indian firms borrowing abroad face foreign exchange risks as RBI publishes September data.
gist: RBI released monthly foreign debt data covering external borrowings for September 2026.
Foreign commercial debt reflects Indian corporate appetite for overseas capital and currency exposure.
Detailed breakdown of automatic versus approval route borrowing amounts in official statistics.
